title: SOS replay gate is vacuous when the active origin has no sequence-tracker entry
description: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py:303-305 (_cancel_from_body) and the render_delete counterpart: a captured-but-undelivered valid cancel envelope replays successfully when last_seen(source_key) is None. That happens when the alert was activated via a direct activate() call (no seq recorded) or when the 256-entry LRU in OriginSequenceTracker (sos_origin.py:202-203) evicts the active origin under a flood of distinct-origin activations. Gate on the activation-time sequence being known, or record it at activate() time.
